The bug was caused by the `getSession()` method in the `CourseEvent` class attempting to access related courses when the event was not fully created, leading to a NullPointerException if `getRelatedCourses()` returned null. This situation arose due to the lack of a null check before accessing the related courses, which was not handled in the previous implementation.
